mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. It is 44 degrees with clear skies at Verona Community Park. The air quality index is currently 77, which is in the moderate range. If you are an early bird, you can spot the International Space Station at 5:45 AM, rising in the west over Mount Horeb and traveling northeast toward the Madison area near Home Depot, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona has several updates for residents. The Mark Drive reconstruction project is moving along, with concrete work finishing up on the west block and excavation beginning on the east block. Additionally, the city is encouraging water conservation through a toilet rebate program and the Eye-On-Water monitoring service, which allows you to track your hourly water usage and set leak alerts.

We have a busy week ahead. Today, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, catch ART House 360 or trivia at Hop Haus Brewing. Looking further ahead, Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee have live music scheduled for Thursday, followed by the Dane County Farmers' Market this Saturday.

Regarding local law enforcement reports, on October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I following reports of erratic driving. Fortunately, no injuries were reported, and the incident remains under review.
Start your day with a sweet note as today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
